introduction: Wisconsin WHEAP helps eligible households with heating and electricity costs. The regular payment season runs October 1–May 15; outside that period, applications may be considered for other available assistance.

who: Wisconsin residential households meeting income and program requirements.
The 2026–27 state income guidance uses 60% of Wisconsin median income; household size matters.
sections.get: A one-time regular payment covering part of energy costs, plus potential crisis or related assistance depending on eligibility and funding.
sections.docs: Prepare household birth dates, all adult income sources, fuel type, supplier and account numbers, and landlord contact if renting. The checklist requests income for the month before applying.
sections.apply:
1. Apply at energybenefit.wi.gov using a current email or mobile number to receive a passcode.
  2. Complete the application and send relevant requested proof.
  3. If disconnected, without heat or electricity, or facing disconnection, immediately call 866-432-8947 instead of relying on routine online review.
sections.after: The local agency may request more information. Respond promptly; the portal says incomplete applications are denied after 30 days. Save a receipt and ask the supplier about arrangements while assistance is pending.

faqs: Yes; outside the heating season, other assistance is considered if funding is available.
Does regular help cover all energy costs?
The portal describes a contribution toward costs.
What if my online passcode expires?
The portal lets you request a new one; initial passcodes last 24 hours.
What income period should I prepare?
The state checklist lists the month before the application month.
Can I wait for routine review if my heat is off?
Call 866-432-8947 immediately for the urgent situation.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
